freeze_takes_effect: at the merge commit of the pull request that adds this file (issue #141, part 1)

amendment_rules.fields: path, kind, invalidates_row13_evidence, sha256_before, sha256_after, and dr and/or ref (+ summary when only ref)
amendment_rules.isa-change: dr >= first_amending_dr required; ref alone refused
amendment_rules.conformance-fix: dr >= first_amending_dr required; ref alone refused
amendment_rules.no-behaviour-change: dr >= first_amending_dr, or ref ('#N' or 'owner/repo#N', form-checked only) with a non-empty summary; invalidates_row13_evidence must be false
amendment_rules.see: DR 0017, section 4 'Change control after the freeze'

pins.why: opcode table, encoding, timing model, register and pin-port model, program-memory size and serial load
fetch-ahead amendment to DR 0001's timing model: the fixed +1 cycle at run-phase entry
WCTL/RCTL control space, register map with per-index latency, the P1/P2 index-map note, pin modes, reset values, first-build points
firmware-visible boot interface: BOOT_STATUS bits, boot-ROM fetch until RUN, hand-over state, layer-1 PM_CRC readout
P1 (CRC/LFSR) and P2 (NRZI + bit stuffing) interface and index-map note; its tables define row 13's exclusions
SUB borrow polarity, SHF leaves Z, logic ops leave C, SHF fills with 0
the core: decode, datapath, flags, ports, WCTL/RCTL decode and registers, P1/P2 primitives, boot-ROM fetch select
program memory: serial load phase, PM_DATA port arbitration and its fixed stall, PM_CRC, BOOT_STATUS[0]
port-to-pin wiring of DR 0001's port table, UIO_DIR/UIO_OD pin-mode logic that makes uio_oe, load-phase CRC mux on uo_out
the assembly language as a programmer writes it: mnemonics, named control indices, encodings, reserved-encoding rules
the independent executable statement of the ISA that the lockstep bench grades the RTL against

row13_excluded_protocols.rule: Row 13's primary protocol must not be any protocol named here. See DR 0017, 'Row 13: how the protocol is chosen'.
dr_0015: USB CRC5/CRC16 and low-speed USB TX/RX
RC-5 / RC-6 infrared, and Manchester/IR generally
isa_design_records: I2C target role and SPI target role as boot-ROM loads (DR 0013, Open items 2)
SPI / QSPI-Pmod flash read, command 0x03 (DR 0012, Context; DR 0013 layer 2)
